content.body:
No other aircraft in history can claim the mystique that belongs to the Ju87 Stuka. Without a doubt one of the least attractive combat aircraft of any era, the Stuka and its menacing appearance served its role as a terror weapon almost as well as its ability to deliver its bomb load with pin-point accuracy. Its bent wing design and gangly fixed landing gear were like no other modern combat aircraft design of the time and have cemented its image into legend.
Fitted with a siren activated on its dive run, the Stuka became an instantly recognizable weapon as soon as it was deployed.
While not especially gifted in any performance profile the Ju87s real talent is in its dive stability. From any angle up to 90 degrees the Stuka can release its bomb load and pull out of its dive run well within 500 meters altitude. This gives the Stuka pilot absolute control when dropping bombs on slow moving armor targets. Hitting stationary targets is trivial.
With a generous aspect ratio and wing loading the Stuka also enjoys a shocking degree of maneuverability for such a large plane. If enemy pilots are over confident against the Ju87 they can easily be surprised to see the huge Stuka turn inside their radius and begin to bring its wing mounted machineguns to bear.
If indeed your enemies are too shocked to recall that they can out-climb the heavy dive bomber easily in addition to accelerating from it easily too, you could be treated to one of the most satisfying air combat victories that can be made ... the dive bomber bringing down the pursuit fighter.
